stories.title: Carousel navigation model: wrap (skip gated) + auto-rotate + velocity swipe-pause

grounding: autoRotateS=8 / resumeIdleS=45 / velocity 0.6 px/ms / travel 0.55 / distance 40px -- ALL from the US-506 acceptance criteria (Iris CIO-locked F-124 spec 2026-07-31, PM-groomed). None Rex-derived.

POLL_MS=250 reused as the bar redraw cadence: 4 Hz over the 8 s default = 32 steps (shipped constant, no second clock introduced).

stories.completionNotes: commit f22b410. WRAP: nextVisibleIndex REWRITTEN to wrap at both ends while traversing only VISIBLE cards, bounded by hidden.length so a <=1-visible-card row terminates instead of spinning. AUTO-ROTATE: shouldAutoAdvance + rotateProgress drive a new thin #rotate-progress bar (z-index 8, UNDER the DTC ribbon's 9 -- an alert must win that band); the bar is REMOVED while paused, never frozen part-filled. VELOCITY: new swipeGesture(dx,dy,dtMs,widthPx,cfg)->{dir,fast} replaces the distance-only swipeDirection in the gesture path; fast->resume, settle->pause. PAUSE SELF-EXPIRY: shouldAutoResume; pausing hangs on ONE document-level pointerdown so a future overlay cannot forget to pause. CONFIG: new pi.display.carousel.* section reaches the browser via a NEW quoted placeholder (__DISPLAY_CAROUSEL__) through the SAME serve-time seam US-483-b built -- deliberately a separate placeholder, not a widened autoDim one, so an auto-dim edit cannot break navigation. states_http_server gained carouselConfig (last param, default None -- positional callers safe) + loadDisplayCarouselConfig; the two loaders now share _loadDisplaySection. VERIFIED the entry point actually injects it (main() is the ONLY construction site) -- the US-494 trap. CONTRACT CHANGE FOR PM/ARGUS: test_carousel_pi_local_cards.py::test_nextVisibleIndex_clampsAtTheLastVisibleCard was RENAMED to ...wrapsPastTheLastVisibleCard -- it pinned the clamp this story deliberately overturns; the invariant it really guarded (never land on a hidden card) is re-asserted, not dropped. GREEN in-loop (synchronous): tests/ui + tests/pi/splash + tests/deploy = 866 passed / 1 skipped, exit 0; 39 new tests proven RED first; ruff clean; validate_config.py passes. HOST GAPS unchanged (Sprints 64-67): make/black/mypy absent on this Windows box -- PM please run mypy at integration (states_http_server.py gained a typed helper). ON-PI GATE OWED (AC validationCriteria, cannot be discharged here): with a gated card hidden, swipe past the last visible card -> wraps to first skipping the gated one; leave it untouched -> auto-cycles at 8 s with the thin bar filling; slow settle swipe -> pauses; fast flick -> resumes; 45 s idle -> auto-resumes. WATCH: the bar shares the band under the top bar with the DTC ribbon -- confirm a live code covers it rather than the two fighting.
acceptance: #12 WRAP: swiping past the last visible card lands on the first and vice-versa; hidden/vehicle-gated cards are SKIPPED (wrap + auto-rotate traverse only visible cards) -- replaces the current clamp (carousel.js:36-48,143-150)
#13 AUTO-ROTATE: visible cards auto-cycle every autoRotateS (default 8 s) with a calm thin top progress bar (time-to-next, no countdown number)

#13 SWIPE-TO-PAUSE via a NEW velocity model (swipe is distance-only today): at pointer-up compute v=dx/dt; FAST if |v|>=0.6 px/ms OR travel>=~55% width -> advance + RESUME auto-rotate; SLOW/settle -> move one card + PAUSE; distance>=~40px still required to count as a swipe at all

stories.title: Consolidate 6 cards to 4: merge Battery + Light + Fuel Trim into one 'Health' card

grounding: NO new numbers introduced. This is a RELOCATION story -- every threshold, verdict rule and freshness window (battery F-9 stale-green data-age guard, light luxStaleSec + null-lux graying, ltft insufficient/drift +/-10%) moved unchanged with its source view function, which was not edited.
Section order + titles (Battery, Light, Fuel Trim) and the retitle 'LTFT Trend'->'Fuel Trim' are verbatim from the US-507 acceptance criteria (Iris CIO-locked F-124 spec 2026-07-31, PM-groomed).
'no engine data' is the gated wording from AC-2. Deliberately NOT reused for the no-data case -- 'does not apply' and 'is broken' are different facts.
Section CSS carries no colour literals: every colour is an existing var(--token) from specs/UI/tokens.css. The merged card forks no palette.

stories.completionNotes: commit 7c02b16. MERGE: dashboard.html gains data-states (PLURAL) naming all three state files; tick() fetches each through a NEW per-tick `stateOnce` cache and renders a section per source via healthCardView/renderHealthCard. The standalone Battery Health, Light and LTFT Trend slots are gone from the DOM/nav. INDEPENDENCE is the load-bearing property: availability resolves PER SECTION, never per card -- routed through one card-level check, a dead UPS would blank the two live instruments beside it, a fabricated 'nothing is readable' built out of one real fault. THE GATE SPEAKS INSTEAD OF HIDING: a standalone card could be `hidden`, but a section inside an always-visible card cannot vanish without leaving a hole, so fuel trim renders the words 'no engine data'; the gate is evaluated BEFORE the data and a gated section carries NO view at all, so a stale ltft-trend file from the last drive cannot paint a trim for an engine that is not running. Ships data-gated="true" so the pre-first-poll window fails closed. The vocabulary now has THREE dispositions (gated / no-data / live), not two. RETITLE IS LABEL-ONLY -- emitter, thresholds, classifier and insufficient guard untouched, Spool's LTFT semantics preserved. The three renderers now take a BODY element, not a card (renderBatteryHealthBody/renderLightBody/renderLtftTrendBody): reaching for their own `.card-body` silently assumed one source per card, the assumption this card overturns. The dead ltft-trend tick branch is DELETED, not left unreachable. TEST HYGIENE, WORTH THE PM'S EYE: my own renamed-renderer pin went RED against CORRECT code -- it grepped the old identifier and matched the COMMENT that documents the rename (a pin that greps a defect's NAME fires on its own documentation -- the exact Session-11 lesson, second occurrence). Fixed with a string-aware _stripJsComments, and the STRIPPER IS ITSELF PINNED (carousel.js:2331 is "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" -- a naive line-comment strip eats its tail, and over-stripping makes an absence assertion pass VACUOUSLY). PRE-EXISTING TESTS WERE ADAPTED, NOT WEAKENED -- flagging one for review: test_render_regression's bench check asserted `'LTFT Trend' not in cards`, which US-507 made VACUOUS (true for the wrong reason once no card carries that name, and it would keep passing if the gate broke entirely); replaced with a POSITIVE assertion that the fuel-trim section painted data-gated='true'. Also test_dashboard_kit's card count 6 -> 4 (class="card" excludes the idle card's `card idle-card`). GREEN in-loop (synchronous): tests/ui + tests/deploy/test_dashboard_kit.py = 414 passed exit 0; tests/pi/splash = 180 passed / 1 skipped; ruff clean on all 5 touched .py. HOST GAPS unchanged (Sprints 64-68): make/black/mypy absent on this Windows box -- no .py PRODUCTION code changed by this story, so mypy risk is nil. ARCHITECTURE DoD MET IN-SPRINT: the card table gained a 'The Health card is MULTI-SOURCE' subsection + the F-096 render note records the relocation. >>> VALIDATION-CRITERIA GAP ROUTED TO PM (offices/pm/inbox/2026-07-31-from-ralph-us507-card-count-validation-gap.md): this story's validationCriteria says '4 cards total', but US-507 ALONE lands at 5 (Standby/System Status/Health/MOTION/Alerts). Absorbing the Motion card into the home slot is US-508's acceptance ('one slot, two faces -- not a separate always-present card'), NOT this story's; US-507's own AC says only 'drop the 2 now-merged standalone cards', which is exactly what shipped. I did NOT delete the Motion card -- that is US-508's scope and would leave a regression window if the sprint were validated between the two stories. PM: re-word the criterion or mark it jointly discharged by US-507+US-508; bigDefinitionOfDone carries the same copied line. ON-PI GATE OWED (A-16): bench + engine off -> Health card shows a real battery reading + real lux, Fuel Trim reads 'no engine data' not a fabricated 0%. WATCH: pull the UPS feed and confirm the Battery section grays ALONE while the Light reading beside it stays live -- merging three cards must not merge their failures.

stories.title: Live/motion card re-issue to locked spec + home-slot idle-live swap
acceptance: re-issue the live card to the CIO-locked spec (2026-07-27-pi-live-instrument-card.md): scrolling compass TAPE under a fixed caret (NOT the built rotating-needle dial); add the GEAR glyph (Spool OBD derivation, '--' when ambiguous); AMBER at 0.6 g (not just the 1.0 g full-scale clamp); grade % + prominent altitude + ~15-min moving trend
HOME-SLOT SWAP: the home slot (position 1) shows the idle card when parked and the live instrument when driving -- one slot, two faces (not a separate always-present card)
honest fallback: stale/absent states/imu -> idle card, never a frozen motion display (states/imu is live @0x69)

[ATLAS CONTRACT RULED 2026-07-31 -- UNGATED] states/imu is the DERIVED display view produced by the ONE dedicated reader/bridge (single owner, DELTA-2); the display is a PURE consumer (never opens bus/I2C, never fuses). Fields: headingDeg 0-359 from mag TILT-COMPENSATED via accel (flag as known-limit if v1 non-compensated -- the READER owns this, not the display); gradePct=tan(pitch)*100; gLat/gLon = tilt-compensated horizontal accel in UNITS OF g; gMag=sqrt(gLat^2+gLon^2) derived-once (don't recompute in the g-circle); altitude = typed-NULL + reason:'no_source' (NO GPS/baro source today -- honest-NA, never fabricated/zeroed; field stays for zero-rework later); available(bool)+ts(fresh) -> stale ts falls to the idle twin. GEAR is NOT imu (Spool OBD derivation, separate producer -- keep it out of states/imu). Raw accel/gyro/mag/temp_c stay on the EDR bus + sensor_schema.py, NOT states/imu

[ATLAS TRANSPORT RULED] the states/imu bridge writes the derived file at ~10-15 Hz latest-wins/lossy (no history on the display path; durable EDR persist stays at the ADR persistHz -- one producer, two cadences); the live card polls states/imu at ~10 Hz off the existing states_http_server (localhost, no-store). Animates the tape+g-trail smoothly with NO new transport. A full SSE/stream is the future EDR-bus target, NOT required here -- do not block on it
